comment: Who may review whose work. This file records identities; it grants no exemptions.
Eligibility is still decided by evaluate_review_eligibility() in
app/orchestrator/routing.py, and nothing here removes, relaxes or bypasses any
member of the Ineligibility enum. A principal listed here can still be refused
a specific review, and routinely will be.
The rule is symmetric. GPT being the independent reviewer does not make GPT
eligible to review GPT's own commits — which is live today, since the nine
authored by the gpt principal despite the branch's claude/ prefix.

principals.reason: Author of e8830c44, 3640c54a, a8005721 and 33968c92. Every Claude session on this host resolves to this one principal, so a fresh session is SAME_PRINCIPAL, not a second opinion.
A genuinely distinct principal, so SAME_PRINCIPAL and SAME_SESSION are satisfied by fact rather than by exemption.
conditions: candidate_sha must be an exact 40-character SHA, never a branch name
the SHA must be re-resolved at decision time; CANDIDATE_SHA_DRIFT voids the review
the reviewer workspace must be checked out at the candidate SHA (REVIEWER_NOT_AT_CANDIDATE)
the reviewer workspace must be read-only and clean (REVIEWER_WORKSPACE_IS_WRITABLE, REVIEWER_WORKSPACE_IS_DIRTY)
must not review a candidate the gpt principal authored

principals.reason: Final authority. Owner approval is a separate act from independent review and must never be encoded as an ActionStatus.
